Maya (People Ops): Quick alert  we've updated the handbook section on mandatory compliance training acknowledgments and added a short localization checklist for managers in APAC. Link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/compliance-ack-2026
Jon P: Is this just wording or are we changing the ack flow?
Maya (People Ops): Flow changed slightly: employees complete the course, then managers confirm acknowledgments in bulk. We added an opt-out for local-law conflicts with a separate local-ack card.
Sofia R: How long is the manager task? My team is large.
Maya (People Ops): Bulk-confirm available in the portal and via CLI: `peopleops-cli bulk-ack --manager jon@redwood.ai --file acks.csv`. Should be quick.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: Managers to bulk-confirm trainee acks by 2026-06-15.
Jon P: Will we keep a retention log?
Maya (People Ops): Yes, acknowledgement records stored for 36 months for audit. Legal signed off.
Sofia R: Thanks  will coordinate localization notes for Japan and Korea.
Maya (People Ops): Appreciate it. We'll post an FAQ and one-page manager guide in #people-ops later today.
